Leadership & Vision

The People Behind Zyra

Our Board of Trustees are the pillars of Zyra Fashion House. They bring together decades of expertise in fashion, business and culture — united by one mission: to build a brand that truly represents and celebrates the African woman.

Founder
Idowu Motunrayo Victoria

The visionary behind Zyra Fashion House, Motunrayo founded the brand with a bold mission — to create a fashion destination that celebrates the beauty, confidence and elegance of the modern Nigerian woman.

Managing Director
Ademola Afolabi

Ademola oversees the strategic direction and day-to-day operations of Zyra Fashion House, driving growth and ensuring the brand delivers excellence at every touchpoint.

Finance Manager
Perfection Emiene Odeh

Perfection manages the financial health and sustainability of Zyra Fashion House, ensuring every investment drives growth and supports the brand's long-term vision.

PR & Communication Manager
Precious Abimbola Chukwu

Precious leads all public relations and communications for Zyra Fashion House, shaping the brand voice and building meaningful connections with our growing community.

Events & Exhibition Manager
Udeowo Chinenye Peace

Peace curates and manages all Zyra Fashion House events and exhibitions, creating memorable experiences that bring the brand to life and connect it with its audience.

Operating Manager
Damol Vulret George

Damol coordinates the core operations of Zyra Fashion House, ensuring every process runs smoothly and the team delivers an exceptional experience to every customer.

Marketing Manager
Khadijah Kachallah Umar

Khadijah drives the marketing vision of Zyra Fashion House, developing strategies that grow the brand's reach and deepen its connection with women across Nigeria and beyond.

Customer Relation Manager
Adedokun Seye Ezekiel

Seye ensures every Zyra customer receives an outstanding experience, building lasting relationships and championing customer satisfaction across all touchpoints.

Our Mission

Style with Purpose

Zyra Fashion House exists to celebrate the everyday elegance of the Nigerian woman — providing stylish, affordable and purposefully curated fashion for every occasion and every version of herself.

ZYRA Fashion House

We create stylish and modern clothing designed to make you feel confident and unique. Explore our collections and discover fashion that reflects your personality.
